cards.note: External plugin ships the official npm-bundle form (dsh.bundle.patch + profile bundle list); no repository-plugins manifest or repositories config exists in the tree.
No dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json anywhere in the tree; the package declares only dsh.bundle.
No Web Client half: no client bundle, no dsh.client declaration, no boot-manifest registration.
Only the tools service is consumed and it is declared in inject; the tree uses no ctx.get and no undeclared service property access.
No optional host service is touched; tools is a hard inject guaranteed by the dsh-base profile this row rides on.
No session/event subscription and no session-derived state anywhere in the plugin.
Host-plane plugin: no self-rendering client and no ctx.sessions use.
No tasks/jobs output tailing; the plugin reads no task stream.
None of the renamed services appear: the only inject is tools, with no httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone use.
No ImageAttachmentRef use and no image metadata persisted by the plugin.
The plugin neither registers nor wraps read_image and keeps no output snapshots.
No custom LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.
No APIProxy or ctx.remote call site; host-plane tool plugin only.
Target is alpha.2, where the marker is restored, and the plugin writes no persisted SessionEvents.
No host-source patch and no internal session-view import.
Not a launcher/SDK/ACP integration and reads no profile files; its cordis.patch.yml is its own bundle layer.
No headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser; console.error is plugin logging, not a stream contract.
No tool presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch-waterfall type is used.
No permission, approval, WebFetch policy, or audit logic.
No custom loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route, browser page, or /api handler.
Not a model provider plugin; no provider login configuration or settings-page patch.
No localization resources or i18n patch; the plugin only emits English log text.
No subagent orchestration or provider/model selector code.
Informational host/deployment behavior; the plugin carries no DeepSeek adapter configuration or user data path.
No PowerShell/Bash persistence or Windows directory-picker workaround.
The bundle does not enable session-log-deepseek and carries no log-egress stance.
No browser acceptance script or wrapper; the plugin has no web surface.
No userQuestions answerer registration.
No agent-preset resolution from persisted sessions and no agent-presets roots.
Does not import isTokenDelta and computes no TPS.
The bundle inserts only its own row; it does not restate the dsh-base composition or carry a telemetry stance.
Does not import @earendil-works/pi-ai or any pi-ai type.
No client-half imports; nothing from @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime.
No client bundle and no client-modules boot-manifest entry to key.
Reads no session timeline or user-message content.
No composer DOM manipulation.
No MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock rendering.
No ctx.connection.api face and no history/transcript reads.
No subagent seed or persisted descriptor construction.
No IWorkspaces/ctx.workspaces or directory UI use.
The plugin produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents.
No ctx.remote use, so no RemoteResult/RemoteError handling.
Packaging was reviewed in the cohort bump: the three peers are minimal and published at alpha.2, and the package has no lockfile or second package manager to reconcile.
No Node-version startup workaround or CI matrix in the tree.
Does not consume pluginInventory/list snapshots.
No client Remote and no host.describe call.
Mounts none of the listed tool/agent packages and composes no profile; its row rides the shipped dsh-base bundle.
No ctx.settings.register/update/get and no settings namespace.
